message.content:
I’m not able to place rides directly from here, but I can walk you through how to do it on the Uber app (or via the web) so you’re all set:

1. **Open the Uber app** (or go to [uber.com](https://www.uber.com) and log in).
2. **Set your pickup location**:
   - In the “Where to?” field, tap the map icon or type “Berkeley, CA” and select the correct city.
   - If you want a specific address, enter it; otherwise, the app will use your current GPS location.
3. **Choose the drop‑off**:
   - Enter your destination or leave it blank if you just want to confirm the ride type.
4. **Select the ride type**:
   - Tap “Choose a ride” (or “Ride options”) and scroll until you see “Uber +” (sometimes labeled “Plus” or “Premium”). Tap it.
5. **Schedule the ride**:
   - Look for the “Schedule” button (usually a clock icon). Tap it.
   - Pick “In 10 minutes” or set a custom time for 10 minutes from now.
   - Confirm the pickup time and location.
6. **Confirm the request**:
   - Review the fare estimate, driver details, and pickup point.
   - Tap “Confirm” or “Schedule” to lock in the ride.

If you prefer, you can also schedule via the Uber website:

- Go to [uber.com/schedule](https://www.uber.com/schedule), log in, and follow the same steps: pick “Uber +”, set the pickup time to “In 10 minutes,” and confirm.

Once scheduled, you’ll receive a notification when a driver accepts and you’ll get the driver’s name, photo, and vehicle details. Safe travels!
